entries.title: Auto-trading
entries.summary: Standing buy and sell orders filled by visiting ships, run from the Mission Control Center.

entries.title: Bank and reputation
entries.summary: Loans with monthly payments from the Commercial Center, priced by your global reputation.

entries.title: Capitalization
entries.summary: The game’s valuation of your company: credits plus modules, conveyors, living quarters, drones, vehicles and stock.

entries.title: Construction costs
entries.summary: Building spends credits, including conveyors and wires, and counts toward capitalization.

entries.title: Contracts and tenders
entries.summary: Deliver resources to organizations for credits, research points and reputation. Late or cancelled contracts cost you.

entries.title: Credits
entries.summary: Your company’s cash. Building, conveyors, wires and capsule shipments all spend it.

entries.title: CRUST Solutions
entries.summary: CRUST Solutions — this is a specialized store created by CRUST to support lunar operations. At CRUST Solutions, you can purchase missing transports, drones, and also order research from external laboratories.

entries.title: Online Market
entries.summary: Buy what production lacks and sell surplus. Prices fall as you add supply, and every shipment goes by capsule.

entries.title: Points of interest
entries.summary: Sites found by rovers, repeaters and probes. Studying them earns research points and rewards.

entries.title: What’s new in 1.0
entries.summary: Planning Mode, roads, rebuilt logistics and the finished story, plus what hotfixes 1.0.6 and 1.0.6.1 changed.

entries.title: Aluminum Oxide
entries.summary: Aluminum Oxide is one of the primary resources generated from Regolith. It can be smelted in a Smelting Furnace to produce Aluminum.

entries.title: Argon
entries.summary: A gas resource listed in the 1.0.6.1 game files. The wiki has no page for it yet.

entries.title: Engineering
entries.summary: Engineering science is mainly used to develop new production technology.

entries.title: Fundamental
entries.summary: Fundamental science is mainly used to expand commerce.

entries.title: Iron Oxide
entries.summary: Iron Oxide is one of the primary resources generated from Regolith. It can be smelted in a Smelting Furnace to produce Steel.

entries.title: Methane
entries.summary: A gas resource listed in the 1.0.6.1 game files. The wiki has no page for it yet.

entries.title: Neon
entries.summary: A gas resource listed in the 1.0.6.1 game files. The wiki has no page for it yet.

entries.title: Neurostimulator
entries.summary: A relatively safe productivity enhancer for colonists. You can use it at your base, sell it on the market, or ship it to Earth and other planets under contract.

entries.title: Organics
entries.summary: Organics are a primary resource generated by hydroponic farms. They must be restored under refrigeration.

entries.title: Quantum Computer
entries.summary: With massive compute power, it excels at a limited class of probelms. Required for constructing data centers and spacecraft, and can also be sold or shipped under contracts to various high-clearance organizations.

entries.title: Rare Earth Minerals
entries.summary: Rare Earth Minerals are one of the primary resources, generated from Basalt. It can be smelted in a Rare Minerals Refinery to produce Rare Earth Elements.

entries.title: Regolith
entries.summary: Extracted from underground with the Regolith Extractor or on the surface of the moon via the Mobile Drilling Rig. Regolith can be refined into oxides by using the Single Regolith Refinery or the Multi-Regolith Refinery

entries.title: Silicon Oxide
entries.summary: Silicon Oxide is one of the primary resources generated from Regolith. It can be smelted in a Smelting Furnace to produce Silicon.

entries.title: Slag
entries.summary: Slag is a byproduct of processing Regolith and Water Ice. It can be used in the production of Smart Concrete and Organics.

entries.title: Social
entries.summary: Social science is used to unlock the market and to develop colonist technology.

entries.title: Supercapacitor
entries.summary: Needed for building quantum computers, control units, and other high-tech late-game modules.

entries.title: Titanium Oxide
entries.summary: Titanium Oxide is one of the primary resources generated from Regolith. It can be smelted in a Smelting Furnace to produce Titanium.

entries.title: Titanium Plates
entries.summary: First you have to research rolling mill on the engineering tab. Scan the area with a ore detector untill you find titanium. Be carefull because of high energy usage. Once you found the titanium place next buildings :…

entries.title: Transparent Aluminum
entries.summary: Required for strong windows and transparent walls as a tougher alternative to glass.

entries.title: Water
entries.summary: Water is a resource produced by melting Water Ice.

entries.title: Battery
entries.summary: A battery for storing excess energy. Capacity: 100,000 units. Provides energy when the mains voltage is low. Has a limited output capacity of 10 MW.

entries.title: Bioreactor
entries.summary: Generates energy by burning organics.

entries.title: Charging Station
entries.summary: TBD.

entries.title: Connector
entries.summary: Connector — a module used to connect lunar base living quarters to the main electrical grid. Connectors enable the delivery of power to equipment, oxygen recirculation systems, and heating. The connector transforms volta

entries.title: Electronic Board
entries.summary: Technology to handle high-voltage systems in a vacuum and low-gravity environments. Allows the installation of a power connector for the interior of the base.

entries.title: Fuel Generator
entries.summary: A fuel generator produces electricity using hydrogen fuel. Unlike cheaper solar panels, the generator can be a source of energy at any time of day.

entries.title: Fusion Reactor
entries.summary: Produces electricity through thermonuclear fusion using energy cells based on Helium-3 as fuel.

entries.title: Large Battery
entries.summary: Device that stores excess energy. Provides power when there is a shortage in the grid. Output limited to: 50 MW. Capacity: 500,000 units.

entries.title: Medium Solar Panel
entries.summary: Generates an average amount of electricity during sunny hours.

entries.title: Projector
entries.summary: Light unit with directional light for illuminating dark areas.

entries.title: RTG
entries.summary: Radioisotope thermoelectric generator. Processes the heat energy released by the decay of radioactive isotopes. Generates a small amount of electricity.

entries.title: Small Solar Panel
entries.summary: Generates a small amount of electricity during sunny hours.

entries.title: Utility Pole
entries.summary: Module for attaching wires. Supports up to 4 connections at the same time. Illuminates the surrounding area.

entries.title: Large Oxygen Receiver
entries.summary: In-game description: High-strength tank for storing large volumes of compressed oxygen at high pressure. Capacity: 50,000 units.

entries.title: Bunk Bed
entries.summary: Provides two sleeping places for colonists. Compact, but less comfortable than a single bed.

entries.title: Bed
entries.summary: Comfortable personal sleeping space for a single colonist.

entries.title: Cafe
entries.summary: A place for colonists to rest after a hard day's work, where a skilled cook and prepare a quality meal solely from organic matter and water. Increases comfort.

entries.title: Electrolysis Plant
entries.summary: Factory that separates water into its constituent elements. Produces oxygen for the colonists to breathe.

entries.title: Hydroponic Farm
entries.summary: A small-scale hydroponic organic food production unit.

entries.title: Ice Melter
entries.summary: Recycles ice into water. Must be installed on the external wall.

entries.title: Indoor Ventilation
entries.summary: A climate system to distribute oxygen among rooms

entries.title: Medical Center
entries.summary: Module for the treatment and prevention of colonist diseases, equipped with an automated operating room. Requires medecines for treatment.

entries.title: Mushroom Farm
entries.summary: Organic food growing facility. Required water, oxygen and the best temperature conditions.

entries.title: Oxygen Receiver
entries.summary: High-strength tank for storing compressed oxygen at high pressure. Capacity: 25,000 units.

entries.title: Cargo Dock
entries.summary: Unloading and storage area for resources brought in by cargo truck.

entries.title: Cargo Drone Reconfiguration Module
entries.summary: Allows converting standard drones into specialized drones for transporting large volumes of resources.

entries.title: Conveyor Elevator
entries.summary: A transportation device to move resources between the surface and the underground level. Only accessible for conveyors.

entries.title: Expedition Control Center
entries.summary: The Expedition Control Center coordinates research missions outside the base. It ensures communication with research groups, allowing the dispatch of transport vehicles with drones or colonists to remote lunar locations.

entries.title: Flight Control Center
entries.summary: Allows you to load cargo pods with speed and efficiency. Equipped with conveyor outputs.

entries.title: Landing Platform
entries.summary: Allows you to prepare cargo pods for shipment. Necessary to fulfill contracts and trade resources.

entries.title: Large Vehicle Assembly Facility
entries.summary: Heavy engineering technologies enable the assembly of large-sized machinery such as the Mobile Drilling Rig and Ice Harvester.

entries.title: Launch Station
entries.summary: Launch Station — is a high-tech platform designed for preparing and launching rockets carrying cargo, equipment, or crew. Within the CRUST project, it is used to export valuable resources to other locations in the solar

entries.title: Rail Gun
entries.summary: Produces and launches problem to search for deposits of valuable minerals, helium-3, and anomolous zones.

entries.title: Repeater
entries.summary: Provides communication with lunar orbital sattelites. Collects data on new objects on the Moon available for exploration. Necessary for communication with objects and transport navigation.

entries.title: Small Vehicle Assembly Facility
entries.summary: Vehicle manufacturing technology allows you to produce smaller vehicles like rover scouts and cargo trucks.

entries.title: Tech Center
entries.summary: The underground Tech Center allows storage, repair and upgrade of light vehicles.

entries.title: Vehicle Hangar
entries.summary: A facility to maintain and upgrade lunar transportation.

entries.title: Drone Reconfiguration Module
entries.summary: The extractor significantly accelerates regolith mining in areas with high concentrations of valuable resources.

entries.title: Extractor
entries.summary: The extractor significantly accelerates regolith mining in areas with high concentrations of valuable resources.

entries.title: Gas Extractor
entries.summary: Extracts gases from crater deposits. Must be placed on a gas deposit.

entries.title: Ice Extractor
entries.summary: Extracts ice from deep rock formations. Must be installed on ice deposits.

entries.title: Multi-Regolith Refinery
entries.summary: Module for efficient regolith processing that extracts all types of oxides.

entries.title: Ore Detector
entries.summary: Scanner for finding ore-rich regolith veins. Uses battery power, depending on the size of the scan area. Cannot be installed indoors.

entries.title: Rare Minerals Refinery
entries.summary: Produces rare earth elements from rare earth minerals.

entries.title: Single Regolith Refinery
entries.summary: Main module for primary regolith processing: Refines regolith and extracts required type of oxide from it. Can only extract one type of oxide at a time.

entries.title: Kitchen
entries.summary: A place where a skilled chef can prepare food fram organic materials and water.

entries.title: Large Hydroponic Farm
entries.summary: A large hydroponic organic food production facility.

entries.title: Assembler
entries.summary: Module for automating the production of high-tech parts from two types of raw materials. Equipped with two conveyor outputs. Requires colonists to operate.

entries.summary: Carbon Fiber Factory -- a high-tech industrial facility designed to synthesize carbon fiber from Organic Materials and Water. Carbon fiber is a strong and lightweight construction material, critically important for assembling complex mechanisms. entries.title: Components Factory
entries.summary: Factory that produces mechanical components from steel and titanium.

entries.title: Fuel Factory
entries.summary: Produce fuel for refueling vehicles and missiles.

entries.title: Hi-Tech Factory
entries.summary: Module for automating the production of high-tech parts and construction supplies from three types of raw materials. Equipped with three conveyor outputs for loading materials.

entries.title: Manufacturer
entries.summary: A complex facility for producing items from four components.

entries.title: Microcircuits Factory
entries.summary: Factory that produces microcircuits from silicon and rare earth elements.

entries.title: Modular Terminals Factory
entries.summary: Factory that produces modular terminals. Requires operators.

entries.title: Pharmaceutical Factory
entries.summary: The Pharmaceutical Center produces medicines and neurostimulators. Requires pharmacist for production.

entries.title: Pressing Module
entries.summary: Inefficient production of Smart Concrete from Regolith.

entries.title: Rolling Mill
entries.summary: Makes plates from titanium and other metals by squeezing metal between rotating rollers.

entries.title: Smart Concrete Factory
entries.summary: Produces smart concrete from silicon and slag in a more productive way than the Pressing Module.

entries.title: Smelting Furnace
entries.summary: Processes oxides into metal ingots. Can only process one of the selected oxide types at a time.

entries.title: Bar
entries.summary: A resting place equipped with a bar and soft drinks of one's choice. Helps to relieve tension.

entries.title: Circle Sofa
entries.summary: Used to create a cozy and functional lounge area for colonists.

entries.title: Coffee Table
entries.summary: A low table for books or cups. Usually placed next to a sofa or group of armchairs. Increases comfort.

entries.title: Couch
entries.summary: Comfy furniture for the colonists to rest on.

entries.title: Dining Table
entries.summary: Dining table for meals and leisure activities. Seats eight.

entries.title: Large Sofa
entries.summary: Plush furnishings for comfortably resting one or more of your people. Makes the place less clinical and more comfortable.

entries.title: Music Box
entries.summary: Listening to music in high quality enhances the mood of the colonists.

entries.title: Small Dining Table
entries.summary: Dining table for meals and leisure activities. Includes two seating places.

entries.title: AI Center
entries.summary: Passively processes data for research, accelerating the discovery process.

entries.title: CPU Data Center
entries.summary: This Complex is installed indoors and increases CPU power to allow control of more modules and units.

entries.title: Data Center

entries.title: Data Processing Node
entries.summary: Dedicated module for handling complex computations. Provides free processing capacity to external clients for a fee.

entries.title: Engineering Lab
entries.summary: Fully equipped laboratory for conducting research. Produces engineering science points.

entries.title: Fundamental Science Lab
entries.summary: Fully equipped laboratory for conducting research. Produces fundamental science points.

entries.title: Large CPU Data Center
entries.summary: TBD.

entries.title: Large Solar Panel
entries.summary: Generates high amounts of electricity during sunny housrs.

entries.title: Sociology Lab
entries.summary: Fully equipped laboratory for conducting research. Produces social science points.

entries.title: Training Module
entries.summary: Training Center. Allows you to enhance the skills og your colonists.

entries.title: Big Water Tank
entries.summary: Tank for storage a large volume of water. Capacity: 50,000 units

entries.title: Bulk Resource Storage
entries.summary: A place to store one type of bulk material with manageable balance. Can be used as a conveyor splitter.

entries.title: Cold Storage Cabinet
entries.summary: Maintains a low temperature in an insulated chamber. Used to store food, medicine, and organic materials. Has conveyor outputs.

entries.title: Component Storage
entries.summary: A storage facility for a large amount of high-tech resources. Can't be connected to conveyors. Capacity: 256 units of each type.

entries.title: Electronics Storage
entries.summary: A warehouse for storing a vast amount of tech resources. Can't be connected to conveyors. Capacity: 256 units of each type.

entries.title: Gas Storage
entries.summary: Structure for storing high-strength containers with Helium-3.

entries.title: General Storage
entries.summary: Drone-only accesible storage of basic resources

entries.title: Large Bulk Storage
entries.summary: A place to store large quantities of bulk material of the same type with manageable balance. Can be used as a conveyor splitter.

entries.title: Large Single Resource Storage
entries.summary: Large solid storage with manageable balance. Can be used as a conveyor splitter.

entries.title: Metals Storage
entries.summary: In-game description: Storage for large quantities of metals and smart concrete. Can't be connected to conveyors. Capacity: 256 units of each type.

entries.title: Multi-Resource Storage
entries.summary: Universal storage of solid resources. Can hold a small amount of each type of resource. Can be used as a conveyor splitter.

entries.title: Refrigerator
entries.summary: In-game description: Vending machine that maintains a low temperature in an insulated chamber. Used to store and dispense simple food.

entries.title: Single Resource Storage
entries.summary: Storage location for solid resource of one type with manageable balance. Can be used as a conveyor splitter.

entries.title: Water Tank
entries.summary: Water storage tank. Capacity: 25,000 units.

entries.summary: Module for the efficient production of components from two types of input material.

entries.summary: A factory for manufacturing parts from steel and titanium.

entries.summary: Increases the regolith processing speed of the Purifier by 25%

entries.summary: Automates the repair of structures by drones if the necessary resources are available.

entries.title: Cargo Drone (Research)
entries.summary: Unlocks access to the configuration of special-purpose drones designed for transporting large volumes of cargo and clearing regolith.

entries.summary: Increases the limit of simultaneous connections to 5 and extends the maximum distance between pole by 20%.

entries.title: Expedition Control Center (Research)
entries.summary: The main module to coordinate expeditions and contracts on the global map. Sets up expeditions, increases the number of communication channels.

entries.title: Fuel Factory (Research)
entries.summary: Processes titanium in a rolling mill to produce titanium plates.

entries.title: Fuel Generator (Research)
entries.summary: Generator adapted for operation in extreme conditions. Generates electricity from hydrogen fuel.

entries.title: Landing Platform (Research)
entries.summary: Enables the building of landing platforms which are required for trade on the global market.

entries.title: Tech Center (Research)
entries.summary: A facility for maintaining and upgrading drones, lunar vehicles and some industrial modules.

entries.summary: Increases resource extraction speed by drilling drones directly from the vein by 150%.

entries.summary: Unlocks the ability to sign resource and scientific contracts with various organizations.

entries.title: Automated Kitchen (Research)
entries.summary: Kitchen with a basic set of tools for preparing space rations.

entries.title: Food Cultivation Technologies (Research)
entries.summary: Hydroponics technology allows organic material to be grown in a controlled environment.

entries.title: Fundamental Science Lab (Research)
entries.summary: Research laboratories provide scientists with all necessary tools for conducting research. Results in additional fundamental science research points.

entries.title: Ice Melter (Research)
entries.summary: A module for producing water by purifying and heating water ice.

entries.title: Large Hydroponic Farm (Research)
entries.summary: A large hydroponic organic food production facility.

entries.summary: Unlocks the technology for building living quarters on te underground levels of the Moon.

entries.summary: Organic food growing facility.

entries.summary: In-Game: Virtual Reality Center. A safe play area for colonists' active recreation.
